name: Giant type, picture passing
look: Two to four words set at 12vw with a photograph showing through the letters under a 35% ink tint; the photograph passes upward through the type as the section crosses the screen.
reduced: The photograph stands still inside the letters.
phone: The photograph stands still in the letters, the type smaller (19vw).

needs.picture: mid to dark tones with detail, no pale sky; the lower half of the picture is what shows
needs.words: a statement of 2 to 4 words and one line under it
